title: Ebner effect: high voltage on crops

tellings.quote: For example, there was something called the Ebner effect, I believe in the 1990s.

plain: In the 1990s, by this account, there was something in Europe called the Ebner effect, in which high voltage applied to crops is said to have changed how they grew. A guest named Dave Rossi mentions it to Michels as an example, saying he believes it dates from that decade and naming no source. He raises it as a case of electricity doing more to living things than standard science allows.
